reading: The sketch lays out a Users admin page: a "Users" heading, an indigo "+ Invite user" button, a search/filter toolbar, a data table with colored status pills, and a pagination bar, all per the typed notes which fully specify the content.

actions.instruction: Add a page heading with the text "Users" at the top left of the page.
Add an indigo filled button with white text reading "+ Invite user" in the top right of the page.
Add a toolbar row below the heading containing a search input with placeholder "Search by name or email…", a "Role: All" dropdown, and a "Status: All" dropdown.
Add a data table below the toolbar with columns "NAME", "EMAIL", "ROLE", "STATUS", "LAST SEEN" and 7 rows of plausible user data. Render the STATUS column as co
Add a pagination bar below the table showing "Showing 1–7 of 48" on the left, with page buttons "1" (current/active), "2", "3", and "Next" on the right.
